results.reason: 247 CMR 9.04(4) requires direct delivery to the patient or patient agent. The stem proposes delivery to a unit charge nurse and records consent to the bedside service. A nursing job title alone neither establishes nor excludes actual patient agency. Consent to the service alone also does not decide designation of the nurse as agent. The regulation directly checked does not categorically bar an appointed nurse-agent. Therefore the unqualified conclusion that this particular proposal fails cannot be established without assuming the nurse is not a designated patient agent. The former inference from routine unit workflow was stronger than the stated facts warrant.
